summary: A cleaned CSV of all ~290,000 active California Contractors State License Board (CSLB) licensed contractors, sourced from the CSLB public data portal bulk download. Fields include business name, city, zip, license number, license class (A/B/C specialty trades), license status, expiration date, and entity type (sole proprietor, corporation, LLC, partnership). California is the largest contractor market in the US — the state has 3x more licensed contractors than the next largest state. No affordable flat-file product exists: the primary commercial buyers (materials suppliers, insurance brokers, equipment rental chains) currently use expensive list brokers like InfoUSA/Data.com at $0.10–$0.50 per record. At $79 one-time for the full statewide file, this undercuts list broker pricing by 99% and directly competes with nothing on Gumroad.

audience.who: Building materials suppliers and distributors (lumber yards, tile wholesalers, plumbing supply) who need to prospect for new contractor accounts in California; commercial insurance brokers selling contractor liability and workers' comp policies; equipment rental chains (Sunbelt, United Rentals) prospecting for contractor fleet customers; construction fintech and payments companies (Procore, BuilderTrend, Knowify) doing outbound to small contractor firms; subcontractors looking to identify and target licensed general contractors in their service region for teaming.

data_wanted: California CSLB licensee bulk data from the CSLB Data Portal at cslb.ca.gov/onlineservices/dataportal/. Fields: business name, DBA name (if any), license number, license type/class (Class A General Engineering, Class B General Building, or Class C specialty trade codes like C-10 Electrical, C-20 HVAC, C-36 Plumbing, etc.), entity type (individual/sole proprietor, corporation, LLC, partnership), license status (Active, Inactive, Suspended, Expired), license expiration date, city, state, ZIP code. The CSLB data portal provides bulk CSV downloads of the full licensee database with no authentication required. Direct download at https://www.cslb.ca.gov/onlineservices/dataportal/ — scoped to Active licenses only (~290,000 records).
